decision_conditions: The proposal would result in a change to the description of development from the original planning permission and cannot be approved under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990. The proposal would not constitute a minor material amendment to the previously approved scheme and fails to comply with Policies BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies (November 2012), Policies DMHB 11, DMHB 12 and DMHD 1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part Two - Development Management Policies (January 2020).
description: The application seeks permission for a variation of Condition 2 (Approved Plans) of planning permission ref. 34843/APP/2024/1191, dated 30-10-2024 (Erection of part single storey, part two storey side and rear extensions, with rear facing first floor Juliette balcony. Erection of single storey front extension. Conversion of roof space into habitable use to include creation of crown roof with dormer roof extension and the installation of 1 x rear facing roof light and 1 x side facing roof light) to include a double-storey front extension and the insertion of dormer windows to both side and rear elevations.
